point: 提出把 model-free RL 控制器、基于控制屏障函数(CBF)的 model-based 控制器、以及对未知系统动力学的在线学习三者结合的控制架构,以在学习过程中保证安全。
quote_en:
we propose a controller architecture that combines (1)
a model-free RL-based controller with (2) model-based controllers utilizing control barrier functions (CBFs) and (3) online learning of the unknown system dynamics, in order to
ensure safety during learning.

point: 作者声称 RL-CBF 是第一个把 CBF 控制器与 model-free RL 结合、对非线性控制系统实现端到端安全 RL 的算法,并通过用屏障函数引导策略探索提升学习效率。
quote_en:
Our main contributions are: (1) we develop the first algorithm that integrates CBF-based controllers with model-free RL to achieve end-to-end safe RL for nonlinear control
systems, and (2) we show improved learning efficiency by
guiding the policy exploration with barrier functions.

point: RL-CBF 在学习过程中以高概率保证安全,且与所用的具体 RL 算法无关。
quote_en:
RL-CBF, guarantees safety with high probability during the learning process,
regardless of the RL algorithm used, and demonstrates greater
policy exploration efficiency.

point: 作者自述重大假设:本工作假定给定一个可被渲染成前向不变的有效安全集 h(s),而计算这种有效安全集本身非平凡且计算量大。
quote_en:
A significant assumption in this work is that we are given
a valid safe set, h(s), which can be rendered forward invariant.

point: 若没有给定有效安全集,可能进入无法保持安全的状态(epsilon_max≥0);未来工作需在学控制器的同时学习安全集。

in future work it will be important to
